name: user-config-store
body: User-config store: the per-user settings file store — locates the config file under the operating system's user config directory, reads it into a key-to-value map over the recognised keys, writes a recognised key (creating the file and its parent directory), unsets a recognised key, lists the set recognised keys, and normalises the `default-template-dir` value to an absolute path on set (`~` to the user's home directory, a relative path against the current working directory); a key outside the recognised set is refused as a usage error. Local filesystem only, no network. It is the storage half of domain.service.load-user-config and backs both the `kalide config` command and `kalide init`'s default-directory resolution. It lives in the Go package `go.github.com/really-knows-ai/kalide/internal/config` (`internal/config`).
